before-another-slice-of-h-a-m-talking-to.text: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...

before-another-slice-of-h-a-m-talking-to.npc: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.

steps.npc: It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.text: Shh! What if they're a human spy come to steal our engineering secrets?

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.

steps.npc: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
[player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?

steps.player: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!

steps.npc: Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.

steps.prompt: Start the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest?

steps.npc: Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.

steps.npc: Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.

options.text: What can I do in the city?

steps.player: What can I do in the city?

steps.npc: Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!

steps.speaker: Ambassador Alvijar
steps.text: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...

steps.npc: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.

options.text: Why did you decide to open the city?

steps.player: Why did you decide to open the city?

steps.npc: For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
